title: Zoom Call Quality for ZDX Integration Requirements

blocks.text: Review the following Zoom application requirements before configuring and using Zoom Call Quality for Digital Experience (ZDX). You must already have a ZDX subscription and ZDX admin access.

blocks.heading: Installing Zoom Call Quality from the Zoom App Marketplace

blocks.text: To install Zoom Call Quality for ZDX from the Zoom App Marketplace:

blocks.item: Sign in to the Zoom App Marketplace.
Click Visit Site to Install. You are automatically redirected to the following URL to access the Zscaler Admin Console:
Log in to the Zscaler Admin Console and follow the configuration steps provided in Configuring Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

blocks.text: The following Zoom API scopes are used with Zoom Call Quality for ZDX:

table: Required by the Zoom API for meeting data.
Required by the Zoom API webhook start and stop meeting notifications.
Required by the Zoom API for user data.

blocks.text: Zoom Call Quality for ZDX receives webhook notifications from Zoom for your organization when a meeting starts or stops. ZDX then makes periodic Quality of Service (QoS) user API calls to retrieve meeting QoS data and makes the data available via APIs to display on the UI.

Data is captured in real time as a meeting is in progress. User and device information garnered from the API for call participants is mapped to ZDX users and devices. While incremental data is available for calls in progress, complete call data is available approximately 10 minutes after a call has ended.
To learn more, see Understanding Zoom Call Quality for ZDX.

blocks.heading: Removing Zoom Call Quality from the Zscaler Admin Console

blocks.text: To remove Zoom Call Quality for ZDX from the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: Click Delete to remove the tenant for Zoom Call Quality.

blocks.heading: Removing Zoom Call Quality from the Zoom App Marketplace

blocks.text: To remove Zoom Call Quality for ZDX from the Zoom App Marketplace:

blocks.item: Sign in to the Zoom App Marketplace.
Click the Zoom Call Quality for ZDX app.
